description.value: A privately operated 50-site campground on Williamson Lake at the edge of Revelstoke, with showers, device charging, and potable water; handy for resupply and Revelstoke's trail network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website fetch failed entirely (ConnectionError), so all evidence comes from OSM tags only. OSM provides explicit tags for drinking_water=yes, shower=yes, toilets=yes, tents=yes, power_supply=yes, internet_access=yes;wlan (free), capacity=50, and sanitary_dump_station=yes — these are used as the sole evidence base. No website content is available to confirm, contradict, or enrich any OSM claim, so contact confirmation fields are null and amenities beyond what OSM explicitly tags remain null.
concerns: Website fetch failed (ConnectionError) — all amenity values are based solely on OSM tags and cannot be verified against the business's own website.

OSM website field contains two semicolon-separated URLs ('http://www.williamsonlakecampground.com;http://williamsonlakecampground.com/'), which is malformed; the first URL was used as the canonical website value.

pre_enrichment_exclude was flagged as true with reason 'prefetch_failed_stub' — this reflects a fetch infrastructure issue, not a closed or phantom business; overridden to 'include' based on OSM evidence.
